cases.prompt: I've been wondering whether we should add some kind of notification system to the app, but honestly I'm not even sure it's a good idea or what it would do. Can you help me think it through before we commit to anything?
rubric: Asks questions one at a time to understand the problem before proposing any solution
Explores the problem space and whether to build at all, rather than jumping straight to a design
Surfaces multiple high-level directions with their tradeoffs
Does NOT write any file, allocate a work unit, or create a branch/worktree
Treats 'don't build this' or 'reframe the problem' as legitimate outcomes, not failures
Hands off to minerva:propose only once a direction is chosen, passing it as an inline argument
